content: Tane maŋau ŋaigonu ŋakmba kusreka wam afu yabri ndakap. Taŋgine yabri maŋau yabuka sine tiŋreknu mineg ŋga sa ndakap. Afu tuku mine magenu tuku wamdus kagli fir ndakap. Afu tuku ŋgumnem pasa sa ndakap.

Tane buk Kuate tuku raŋgun mayenu katesenaig. Ta tuku kiŋo dabro amo nyam paraniŋgit taŋaŋ tane Kuate tuku pasa tugusek tam tuku paratiŋguwa. Tane taŋamba nyumba minap ma ma sugo-sugowap le muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgamŋgat.
Ndame mayenu abo ŋak
Ndame ande taŋgo kameŋge gisleknu ŋga te-sinaig ta Kuate nu ndame ta madimba nu ndame suŋgo ŋgina ta Kristus. Ndame ta abo ŋak. Tane nu tugum prowap.

Promba ndame abo ŋak taŋaŋ minmba Kuate tuku wande palmbim tuku taŋgine ŋgarosu patikap. Taŋawap sulumba tane Kuate tuku pris taŋaŋ mayok ka taŋgine maŋau magenumbi Kuate atraukanu sukamŋgaig. Tane Yesus Kristus ndoŋ ulendikade le Kuate nu tane tuku atrau agaŋ ta nzalite.
Kuyar pasa teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ye ndame suŋgo madimba tumba Sion tumbraŋ tuku ndame ŋakmba nu mbolŋge saŋgri tiŋgam tuku palmbimŋgit. Ande nu ndame ta tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋguwa ta nu tumail pulunuŋgat ŋgate. Aisaia 28.16

content: Tane ndame ta tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋgade mbal nu tane am mbolŋge ndame suŋgokanu. Nane nu talade mbal Kuate tuku kuyar pasa teŋenmba nane tuku sakate.

content.text: Ndame ande ndame wande pilig mbal gisleknu ŋga te-sinaig. Ndame ta kile wande ta tuku ndame ŋakmba nu mbolŋge saŋgri tiŋgade ŋgate. Mune 118.22

content: Kuyar pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Taŋgo kame ndame ta mbolŋge kupe daŋŋga mbikeka barinuŋgaig ŋga sakate. Aisaia 8.14-15

content: Kuate nu o buk sakina taŋamba ndo nu tuku pasa nda isanu sukmba ŋgumnede mbal nane bariŋgade ta

tane taŋamba kuga. Tane Kuateŋge maditiŋgina. Tane nu tuku kuasmbi ndindo minig. Tane Suŋgo Kuate tuku pris mbal. Tane nu tuku mbal mayok ka nu tuku tur maŋau mayenu afu saniŋgam tuku nu ma make sinamŋge tane wika kilmba nuŋe bulu mayenu mbolŋge patikina.
Tane buk nyu kugatok mbal minnaig. Kile tane Kuate tuku mbal nyu ŋak minig. Kuate nu buk tane mape ndakina. Kile nu tane mapekate.
Wam pagu pasa yeki yeki
Tira kame, tane samba mbolok mbal mayok ka kile teŋge rawe taŋgo taŋaŋ minig. Tane ŋgarosu kikoŋ tiŋgam tuku nzali ŋakmba ŋgumneniŋgap. Ŋgarosu tuku nzaliŋge taŋgine kanu ŋaigo siglikate.

Tane Kuate dubi ndade mbal ŋgamukŋge mine mayenu mbolŋge minap. Tane taŋawap ta nane tane wam ŋaigonu kanu ŋga ŋgumnem pasa tiŋguwaig sulumba tane tuku mine mayenu kaŋgeramŋgaig. Kaŋgerwaig le Kuate nu nane tugum prowa le nane Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgamŋgaig.
Kilke mbol mbal naŋgine sugo yimyam patikade ta tane Kuate tuku mbal tukunu maŋau mayenu te-mayokmba nane kumnemŋge minap.

Kilke tuku gabat suŋgo ko gabat foŋfoŋ nu tuku nyu mbolŋge pirokade nane ŋakmba kumnemŋge minap. Gabat foŋfoŋ nane mbarde mbal lafu ŋayonu niŋmba wam mayede mbal nyu kile-duŋgam tuku nu patikate le nane piro ta kade.
Tane maŋau tiŋreknu kumba tambi nane wamdus tugusek kugatok mbal tuku miŋge tukulniŋgam tuku Kuate nu nzalite.

Kuate nu tane muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgit mbal tane tukul tuku piti kugatok taŋaŋ likap. Sine tukul pasa kumnemŋge mine ndakeg ŋga wam ŋaigonu afu kam tuku idus ndawap. Tane Kuate kumnemŋge minmba nu tuku piro mbal minap.
Tane taŋgo ŋakmba idusniŋmba ande maim maim tuwe ndakap. Tane Kristus tuku kuasmbi tuku kume purmba Kuate kumnemŋge minmba nu tuku nyu kuraukap sulumba sisar tuku nyu idusap.
Piro mbal, tane taŋgine kulat mbal tuku nyu idusniŋmba nane kumnemŋge minap. Kulat mbal raŋgun magenu ta ndo kuga. Miŋge saŋgrinumbi tane kulatkade mbal mata kumnemŋge minap.
Tane mbar ndade le afu ake sinaŋ tane kattiŋgig le sine Kuate tuku mbal ŋga wamdus piti kugatok rar kurade ta tane wam mayede.
Tane mbarde le afuŋge kattiŋgig le tane wamdus piti kugatok rar kurade ta alo kugatok. Tane maŋau tiŋreknu kade le kattiŋgig le tane ndek wamdus piti kugatok rar kurade ta Kuate nu nzalite.
Tane wamdus piti kugatok piti kurawam tuku Kuate nu tane wikina. Kristus nu sinenu ŋga rar suŋgo tina sulumba piti mbolŋge sine nu tuku maŋau dubiwam tuku tumsiŋgina.
Nu mbar ande ke ndakina. Yabri pasa ande mata sa ndakina.

Nane afuŋge nu tumail pannaig ta nu lafumba nane tumail pan ndaniŋgina. Nane nu ŋgaro rar suŋgo tunaig ta nu lafumba riroŋ pasa ande sa ndaniŋgina. Kuate nu taŋgo kumumbi pileniŋgit ŋga nu wam ta ŋakmba nu wai mbolŋge patikina.
Siŋgine maŋau ŋaigonu kusreka mine kitek mayenu mbolŋge minbe ŋga nu sine tuku une kilmba ail kazrai mbolŋge kumna. Nu tuku mbamake taŋge sine tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge siŋgina le sine mage mineg.
Sine sipsip taŋaŋ ndin mbarmba ŋgisika mingeŋ ta kile Sipsip Kulat Taŋgo tugusek tugum proweg le nu sine tuku kanu kulatkate.
